dedupe_keys.name: communaute d agglomeration de la rochelle public transport datasets

description: Communauté d'agglomération de La Rochelle: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'agglomération de La Rochelle. Coverage: Communauté d'agglomération de La Rochelle. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Transport Yelo - GTFS itinéraires des bus; Transport Yelo - GTFS stop des bus; Transport Yelo - GTFS stop times des bus; Transport Yelo - GTFS shapes des bus. Formats seen: CSV, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
